title: Air conditioner control experiment (10 subjects, 4 classes, 25 EEG ch)
description: EEG recordings from 10 healthy participants performing an online P300-based brain-computer interface task to control an air conditioner. A four-class visual oddball paradigm on an LCD display was used, with target and non-target flashes. Data were recorded from 25 channels at 500 Hz, with 50 training and 30 testing blocks per subject. The dataset supports research on ERP-based BCIs for home appliance control and inter-subject transfer learning.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with an actiCHamp (Brain Products) active electrode system, 25 channels placed according to the 10-20 system, sampled at 500 Hz, and referenced to linked mastoids. Participants viewed flashing visual stimuli on an LCD display with a 750 ms stimulus onset asynchrony. Each subject completed 50 training and 30 testing blocks in a single session, with online visual feedback.
